ADYEN_API_KEY.description: Adyen says API keys must be protected, rotated, and not exposed in client-side code. Generating a new one activates it immediately and leaves the previous key working for twenty-four hours, which is the overlap to move over in. The name is convention.

ADYEN_CLIENT_KEY.description: Adyen says the client key is not used for API requests and exists so Drop-in and Components can collect card details in the browser. Only the environment prefix is documented, so the pattern checks that and nothing more. The name is convention.
